hints.title: Mandatory Requirement Aggregate
hints.text: Count the number of mandatory courses required for each major.

hints.title: Student Performance Metrics
hints.text: Aggregate student grades in their major mandatory courses, elective courses, and overall weighted grade point average.

hints.title: Eligibility Filtering
hints.text: Filter students who earned an 'A' in all mandatory major courses, took at least two major electives with grade 'A' or 'B', and achieved an overall average grade point average >= 2.5.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
WITH MandatoryMajors AS (
    SELECT major, COUNT(course_id) AS mandatory_count
    FROM courses
    WHERE mandatory = 'Yes'
    GROUP BY major
),
StudentStats AS (
    SELECT 
        s.student_id,
        s.major,
        SUM(CASE WHEN s.major = c.major AND c.mandatory = 'Yes' AND e.grade = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mandatory_a_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN s.major = c.major AND c.mandatory = 'No' AND e.grade IN ('A', 'B') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS elective_count,
        ROUND(SUM(e.gpa * c.credits) / SUM(c.credits), 2) AS avg_gpa
    FROM students s
    JOIN enrollments e ON s.student_id = e.student_id
    JOIN courses c ON e.course_id = c.course_id
    GROUP BY s.student_id, s.major
)
SELECT ss.student_id
FROM StudentStats ss
JOIN MandatoryMajors mm 
  ON ss.major = mm.major 
 AND ss.mandatory_a_count = mm.mandatory_count
WHERE ss.elective_count >= 2
  AND ss.avg_gpa >= 2.5
ORDER BY ss.student_id ASC;
```

complexity.notes: CTE aggregation followed by join filter on required counts.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Single join without CTE cannot compare individual student counts against major-wide course totals.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Structure multi-faceted eligibility criteria cleanly using CTEs and conditional aggregations.
